# AI001: GX Works3 link-device point counts

## Scope and safeguards
- This skill is currently limited to station 3, model `NZ2GNS12A2-14DT`, in an offline test project.
- It reads the CSP+ analysis JSON and the GX Works3 CC-Link IE TSN configuration screen. Do not edit the source archive, parser, or existing import and file-dialog skills. Treat the generated JSON as read-only.
- Never connect to or write to PLC hardware.
- Do not click `設定を反映して閉じる`, `設定を破棄して閉じる`, `適用`, or any project-save command. Leave the configuration window open.
- GUI value entry requires a separate, explicit user approval for the exact target station, selected items, category, current values, and planned values. The invocation request alone is not that approval.
- If the requested station/model, project, screen, editable cell, or warning state is ambiguous, stop and hand off to the user.

## Inputs
Obtain these inputs before planning:
- Station number: only `3` is supported.
- Model: only `NZ2GNS12A2-14DT` is supported.
- Category: `initial`, `minimum`, or `maximum`.
- Target items: optionally select one or more of `RX`, `RY`, `RWr`, and `RWw`. If omitted, target all four as before.

If a required input is missing or outside this initial scope, ask for clarification or stop. Use the all-four target only when the optional target-item selection is omitted, as specified above. Never substitute a different category or target-item selection. When target items are specified, only those items are change candidates; all unselected items are read-only and must not be edited.

## CSP+ source and plan
Use `input/cspp/nz2gns12a2-14dt-ai001-point-counts.json`, generated by `input/cspp/parse_cspp_point_counts.ps1` from the Japanese CSP+ ZIP.

1. Require `analysisStatus` to be `validated` and `.model` to exactly match the requested model. Confirm the selected profile is the Japanese CC-Link IE TSN profile, not a `(CCIEF)` entry.
2. Resolve the requested category only for the selected target items (all four when no target-item selection was supplied):
   - `initial` -> `.parameters.<name>.initial`
   - `minimum` -> `.parameters.<name>.minimum`
   - `maximum` -> `.parameters.<name>.maximum`
3. Validate each selected result as an integer within its corresponding minimum and maximum. Preserve the JSON units: RX/RY are bits; RWr/RWw are words. Do not convert between bytes, bits, and words. Do not resolve or use unselected items' category values as change candidates.
4. Report the selected items, category, planned values, and source labels before any GUI entry. If the JSON is missing, invalid, or for another model, run the bundled parser with an explicit, new output path and model, then re-read and validate that generated JSON. Do not overwrite the checked-in analysis JSON:

   ```powershell
   powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File input/cspp/parse_cspp_point_counts.ps1 -ArchivePath input/cspp/0x0000_NZ2GNS12A2-14DT_1_ja.CSPP.zip -OutputPath output/ai001_point_counts_regenerated_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.json -Model NZ2GNS12A2-14DT
   ```

## Read and stage in GX Works3
1. Use Computer Use only. Locate the open GX Works3 window titled `CC-Link IE TSN構成` and verify it belongs to the intended offline test project. Do not use shell or window-manager operations to control the UI.
2. **Maximize before inspecting the station table.** First determine from the current Computer Use observation whether the configuration window is already maximized; if so, do nothing. If it is not maximized, look for and use its accessibility-exposed maximize button. If that button is unavailable, visually inspect the window with Computer Use and, only if the title bar is clearly identifiable and unobstructed, double-click an appropriate title-bar area (not a title-bar button). Do not use fixed coordinates, shell commands, or window-manager operations. Do not horizontally scroll, select point-count cells, or inspect values in the small window.
3. After confirming it was already maximized or performing one maximize action, take a **fresh Computer Use observation** and verify the window is maximized. If it is still not maximized, do not repeat the action; stop and hand off to the user. Once maximization is verified, confirm the enlarged layout has stabilized and check whether the headers and point-count columns for **RX, RY, RWr, and RWw** are all visible simultaneously. If they are, **do not scroll horizontally at all**. Only if one or more columns remain hidden after verified maximization, perform the minimum necessary horizontal scroll, then observe again. Never alternate repeatedly between maximizing and scrolling or scroll merely to reconfirm an already visible column. If the required cells remain ambiguous after one deliberate adjustment, stop and ask the user for help.
4. Locate the target station by matching both station number `3` and model `NZ2GNS12A2-14DT`; never identify it by row position alone. Use the maximized layout to inspect the target row.
5. Read the current RX, RY, RWr, and RWw point counts from their **point-count** columns, not their start/end-address columns. Also record the start and end addresses for all four items. Do not activate or edit a cell while reading. Record current values separately from the plan, including values for unselected items.
6. Compare planned values only for selected target items. Unselected items are never change candidates, even when their current values differ from the CSP+ value for the requested category. If all selected items already match, make no GUI input and report that no change is needed.
7. If any selected value differs, present the exact station, model, selected items, category, all four current point counts, the planned value for each selected item, and the per-item changes. Wait for explicit approval of that exact plan before entering anything.
8. After approval, enter only selected point-count cells that need changes, one at a time, using the currently observed and identified controls. Never enter an unselected item or change an address or other field. If a value is rejected without the known correction dialog below, or the entry cannot be committed or verified, do not substitute another value; stop for human handling.
   - The only warning that may be accepted without another user approval is the exact GX Works3 dialog `点数の設定値が範囲外です。入力されたデータを <value> に変更します。` Accept it only when **all** of these are true: the just-edited cell is confirmed as the pre-approved station's pre-approved RX/RY/RWr/RWw point-count cell; `<value>` is clearly readable as a non-negative integer; and the dialog requests only this point-count correction, not an operation on another field or item.
   - When all conditions are met, use Computer Use to click the dialog's accessible `はい` button once; this confirmation is covered by the original approval for the selected item and does not require an additional approval. Immediately read back the point counts and start/end addresses for all four items. If an unselected item or any address changed unexpectedly, stop further entry and report it. Otherwise, record the correction and continue with the remaining selected items. A correction that differs from the CSP+ value is not, by itself, a reason to retry or stop; do not re-enter the requested value.
   - If the dialog text is different or ambiguous, the number cannot be read or parsed, the edited cell/target cannot be confirmed, or the warning requests anything beyond the point-count correction, stop without choosing a dialog button. Also stop further entry if the post-confirmation readback shows an unexpected change, or if another warning or error appears. Never edit addresses to compensate.
9. Re-read all four counts and all four start/end addresses in the current maximized layout, then inspect the Output pane for errors or warnings. Avoid unnecessary scrolling. Report every item in a table with its before value, CSP+ target (or `対象外`), whether GX Works3 corrected it, final displayed value, whether it changed from before, and any warning or incomplete status. Clearly label a corrected value as a GX Works3 correction; do not call it the CSP+ minimum unless independently verified. Do not dismiss or accept other warnings automatically.
10. Leave all values pending in the open configuration screen. Do not apply, reflect-and-close, discard, save, or write to PLC.

## Stop conditions
Stop without further entry if the project/network is not the expected test configuration, the station/model do not match, CSP+ validation fails, the current values cannot be read, or an unexpected/ambiguous warning or error appears. The known point-count correction dialog may be accepted only under all conditions in step 8. Stop and hand off to the user if Computer Use cannot reliably identify or operate the screen.
